We invite applications for two PhD positions and two postdoctoral positions in Human–Computer Interaction at the University of Copenhagen, Denmark. The application deadline is 22 May.

The positions are part of a research project that aims to build scientific foundations for VR interaction techniques by applying sensorimotor theories, methods, and models to HCI.

To do that, we are looking for candidates with a strong interest and skills in bridging HCI with fields studying the human sensorimotor system.

We offer an ambitious research environment within the scientifically and socially thriving Human-Centered Computing section at the Department of Computer Science.

Further details can be found at:
